  1. analytical
  2. ExactModel

Uses of Class
analytical.ExactModel

Packages that use ExactModel
Package
Description
analytical
Analytical JMVA model layer: constants, parameters and the model data structure of the alphanumeric MVA solver, as described in the JMVA chapter of the user manual.
common.definitions
Definition of the JMT simulation model data structure (CommonModel, StationDefinition, ClassDefinition, ...) shared by JSIMgraph and JSIMwiz.
common.definitions.convertors
Converters of the JMT model definitions.
exactModelUtils
Utilities for the exact solution of product form queueing networks in JMVA.
jmva
JMVA application entry point: the wizard based alphanumeric MVA solver of JMT.
jmva.engine
Dispatcher of the JMVA GUI: it collects the model from the panels, runs the selected solution algorithm and returns the results for display.
jmva.link
Link between the JMVA GUI and the model data structures of the JSIM graph editor.
jmva.panels
Panels of the JMVA wizard: Classes, Stations, Service Times, Service Demands, Visits, Reference Stations, What-if and Comment tabs, as described in the JMVA chapter of the user manual.
solvers.dispatchers
Solver dispatchers of JMVA, which select and drive the appropriate exact or approximate solution algorithm for the model under study.
solvers.dispatchers.wrappers
Wrapper solvers used by the JMVA dispatchers.
solvers.priority
Priority support of the JMVA solvers: Priority MVA (P-MVA) and Related Workload Approximation (RWA) calculators for models with priority classes.
